entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: histogram subquery input is %T with %s sample kind
entries.rationale: the preceding lowerExpHistogramValuedShape call returned matched=true for the subquery's same histogram-valued inner expression. Every successful matched producer publishes a HistogramProjection or histogram-flagged VectorSetOp whose RowType is SampleKindHistogram, so this split sample-kind half of the former row-shape assertion remains an internal invariant.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery step must be positive, got %s
entries.rationale: the PromQL parser rejects negative subquery steps; zero is the valid default handled before this guard

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: histogram subquery input matched no histogram-valued shape for %v
entries.rationale: rangeFnOverExpHistogramSubquery admits this path only after recognizing the subquery inner with isExpHistogramValuedShape. This function re-dispatches that identical inner through lowerExpHistogramValuedShape, the paired producer for the same predicate, so matched=false is an internal recognizer/producer disagreement.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: histogram-valued subquery requires query eval-time context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: query handlers always supply evaluation context through LowerAt or LowerAtRange; only the raw test and tooling Lower entry can omit it, and the guard tests subqueryGridUnavailable specifically — the state subqueryGridCtx returns only when no evaluation anchor was threaded through, never for a window that merely spans no anchor
